name: Admin Accounting Card Snapshots
description: Superuser manages weekly credit-card balance snapshots at /panel/accounting/cards: list with latest-debt-per-card chip, filters (date range, debt range, card multi-select), create via modal (date defaults to today, card picked from a dropdown fed by the CreditCard catalog; the Deuda input is gone — debt is server-computed as cupo − disponible and previewed in the form, which blocks disponible > cupo), edit prefill (legacy names outside the catalog injected as an extra option) and delete with ConfirmModal. Registering a snapshot dated on/after the cycle Friday silences the weekly card-debt email reminder. The card filter defaults to the active catalog cards as removable chips (clearing them surfaces historical names); its options are the union of catalog and snapshot names, and a saved tab in the URL wins over the preselection.
